name: create_greeting_service
description: Creates a GreetingService with a greet(name) method
prompts: This Maven project (pom.xml already uses spring-boot-starter-parent 3.3.4 with spring-boot-starter-web) needs a service class under package com.optarena.greeting. Create src/main/java/com/optarena/greeting/GreetingService.java as a @Service-annotated class with a public method `String greet(String name)` that returns the string "Hello, " followed by the given name followed by "!" (e.g. greet("World") returns exactly "Hello, World!"). No HTTP endpoint, controller, or main application class is needed for this task - just the service class.
